preconditions.description: The number of operations is between 1 and 200,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(float(output_lines[i]) - expected_average[i]) < 10**-6 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the average of the sequence after the corresponding operation, with an absolute or relative error not exceeding 10^-6.

invariants.description: The sequence always has at least one element.
